title: QVC Group, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-20
summary: QVC Group, Inc. filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection on April 16, 2026, and on April 17 received a Nasdaq delisting notice. Nasdaq has determined to delist the company's Series A common stock (QVCGA) and 8.0% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock (QVCGP), with trading suspended at market open on April 24, 2026. The company does not intend to appeal. Series B common stock is being downgraded from OTCQB to OTCID Basic Market.
key_points: QVC Group and affiliates including QVC, Inc. filed voluntary Chapter 11 petitions in the Southern District of Texas on April 16, 2026
Nasdaq issued a delisting determination based on the bankruptcy filing, public interest concerns, concerns about residual equity interest, and ability to maintain continued listing compliance
Trading of QVCGA and QVCGP suspended at market open on April 24, 2026; Form 25-NSE will be filed to remove securities from listing and registration
Series B common stock (QVCGB) moved from OTCQB Venture Market to OTCID Basic Market effective April 20, 2026
Company does not intend to appeal the Nasdaq delisting determination
Company expects stock to trade on OTC Markets Group following suspension, but provides no assurance of trading market quality
Company states equity holders will not receive distributions and all interests will be cancelled under the prepackaged Chapter 11 plan
